projects.title: MBY TAILS
projects.tools: Figma, Canva, React, Tailwind CSS, JavaScript, Node.js, Express, Firebase, Git
projects.description: An intelligent animal welfare management platform designed to streamline shelter operations and accelerate pet adoptions for MBY Pet Rescue and Sanctuary. Features an end-to-end design system, accessible UI flows, interactive matchmaking tools, and automated AI bio generation.

projects.title: Bulldogs eXchange
projects.tools: Unity, Figma, Visual Asset Integration, C#
projects.description: A 3D Weeping Angel horror interactive game and storytelling experience created in Unity. Highlights custom retro typography, immersive UI/UX layout design, C# mechanics, and video editing for dynamic gameplay sequences.

projects.title: Moonstoria Hotel
projects.category: Full Stack Web Development, UI/UX Project
projects.tools: MongoDB, Express, React, Node.js, Tailwind CSS, Figma, Canva
projects.description: A full-stack hotel booking interface featuring a dark gothic aesthetic, high-contrast typography, and atmospheric visual storytelling. Crafted custom visual assets in Figma and Canva, paired with an intuitive booking flow, custom crypt/room selection inputs, and smooth micro-interactions across modern web frameworks.

projects.title: ICONIK Tote Shop
projects.description: An e-commerce prototype and brand identity project blending art, fashion, and functional design. Features high-fidelity Figma prototypes, custom typography layouts, product showcase carousels, and minimalist navigation.

projects.title: Fila Fusion ZH
projects.description: A modern web system and interface design concept crafted for FILA FUSION Zhang Hao edition. Features custom brand layout components, high-contrast typography, seamless authentication UI, and campaign media integration.

projects.title: MBY TAILS Poster
projects.description: A promotional capstone poster for TAILS: An Intelligent Animal Welfare Management System. Features a duo-tone collage composition with halftone textures, structured typography hierarchy, and branded visual elements tailored for formal academic presentation and public display.

projects.title: Capstone Respondents PubMat
projects.description: A promotional digital pubmat designed to drive user survey participation for the TAILS capstone evaluation. Combines playful typography, custom QR asset design, and web preview mockups for social media distribution.

projects.title: ZH Cup Sleeve Event PubMat
projects.description: A promotional poster designed for a fan-organized cup sleeve event celebrating ZEROBASEONE’s Zhang Hao on his birthday. Inspired by MotoGP racing aesthetics and FILA FUSION x Ducati campaign visuals, the graphic combines high-speed motion typography, futuristic dark UI accents, and vibrant Ducati-red color blocking.

projects.title: This is Kei! Personal Intro PubMat
projects.description: A personal graphic design piece built for self-introduction. The graphic combines playful collage aesthetics with a bold, youth-centric color scheme to make a memorable first impression.

projects.title: PAPAYA Thread Line Brand Board
projects.description: A motorsport-inspired brand identity board developed for Papaya Thread Line, a streetwear concept rooted in Formula 1 racing culture. Drawing directly from McLaren’s iconic papaya orange livery and paddock aesthetics, the identity translates high-speed track energy into bold, wearable fashion under the tagline "From Grid to Street — Mc-Engineered to Wear!"
